title: Tactile one-to-one scratch: pre-meeting + follow-ups
text:
Context: quick 25m sync with direct report (Devon Park). Focus = unblock immediate infra regression, align on Dedicated capacity ramp, and a short career check-in. Tone = tactical, supportive; surface open questions and select 2 action items to close before next sync.

Meeting goals:
- Confirm root cause hypothesis for KV-cache regression impacting long-tail latency.
- Decide who owns the hotfix vs. rollback path and set a short deadline.
- Align on Dedicated capacity forecast for Q4 (Devon to propose numbers).
- Quick career coaching: signal next stretch project and document skill targets.

Agenda (25 min):
1) 0-5m: quick personal check-in (energy, load) — calibrate availability for on-call burn this week.
2) 5-12m: regression update (Devon) — what we know, repro steps, impact surface, tentative mitigation.
3) 12-18m: decision point — rollback vs. targeted patch. Who owns each path? timeline?
4) 18-22m: Dedicated capacity ask — confirm anticipated steady-state GPU hours and any verticals that need isolation.
5) 22-25m: career / next steps — one concrete growth goal for next 6 weeks and one delivery milestone for visibility.

Signals / prompts to surface during the discussion:
- "Which customer routes are seeing the tail latency spikes? Can you show the trace that most clearly reproduces the KV cache miss pattern?"
- "If we rollback to v1.3.9, what downstream tests fail? Perf regression risk?"
- "If we patch, what's the minimal test matrix to feel safe for canary?"
- "Are there scheduling conflicts (on-call, PTO) that would block a midnight hotfix?"
- "For Dedicated capacity, what's the conservative vs optimistic hour estimate for the next two quarters? Any customers expecting spikes?"

Current notes from Devon (read before the call):
- Observed: 95th/99th token latency jumps after minute-10 in long-history sessions. Suspect regression after kernel change in PR #1187.
- Repro: local repro uses long prefix + recurrent KV reuse; flaky in CI but stable on a tiny subset of internal traces.
- Quick mitigation: prefix-ttl threshold patch (small risk), canary config toggle to reduce seq_len for specific customer.
- Risk of rollback: reintroduce previous memory pressure fix; team flagged potential OOMs on large models (ticket INFR-4478).

Decision map (draft):
- If repro is trivial and patch < 4hrs -> patch and canary to 1% traffic for 24h. Owner: Devon + Rahul. Target: Aug 14 EOD.
- Else -> rollback to v1.3.9, schedule warm-up and memory tests with SRE, take 4h maintenance window. Owner: Kiran to coordinate with SRE. Target: Aug 13 night.

Concrete action items to assign in the meeting (capture here and check back):
- Devon: produce single-repro-case script and attach to JIRA INFR-4523 (due 2026-08-12).
- Rahul: draft minimal unit + integration tests for KV path and open PR for review (PR stub exists; finish tests) (due 2026-08-13).
- Kiran: ping SRE on staging flakiness and reserve rollback window if needed; confirm maintenance cadence (due 2026-08-12).
- Devon + Product: re-evaluate Dedicated capacity request and send a 1-paragraph justification for sales (due 2026-08-18).
- Kiran -> Devon: set one career stretch goal: lead roll-forward plan & the postmortem write-up; deliver a short slide in next demo (due 2026-09-01).

Notes-to-self for coaching segment:
- Praise: call out quick triage and useful traces Devon found last night (specific praise is important).
- Development ask: ask if Devon is interested in owning a small on-call rotation to level-up incident leadership (frame as low-risk shadowing).
- Calibration: make sure to surface how this incident ties to promotion criteria (ownership, cross-team communication, reliability impact).

Open questions to bring up / unanswered items before meeting close:
- Can we short-circuit customer-visible latency by applying canary config? Who has permission to flip that flag?
- Is there a known interaction between the kernel change and our recent quantization tweaks? (verify with Rahul)
- Any dependent PRs that block a simple rollback (list in JIRA).

After-meeting checklist (to update immediately):
- Update INFR-4523 with the chosen decision and owners (Kiran).
- If patch route chosen: update canary config and monitor dashboards for 6h increments (Devon).
- If rollback: schedule memory soak and block merges to the affected branch until cleared (Kiran + Release Eng).
- Create follow-up calendar invite for a 15m sync in 48h to review progress.

Tone notes / personal reminders:
- Keep the call focused — stop technical deep dives after 12 mins, move unresolved items to a follow-up with Rahul present.
- Use explicit completion commitments (owner + date).
- End on 1 positive datapoint (e.g., service still serving 99% of traffic without error).

Rough timeline for the week (for my calendar):
- Aug 11: one-to-one (this meeting).
- Aug 12: decision update & SRE ping.
- Aug 13-14: patch work / rollback window.
- Aug 18: Dedicated capacity blurb due.

Quick scratch notes (brain dump):
- Consider pairing with DevRel to make a short runbook for KV-cache incidents (low-effort doc).
- Check payroll/salary band note for Devon ahead of calibration meeting.
- Follow up with Product on expected Q4 model sizes that might influence dedicated capacity ask.

End.
